typeHelp.periodic: A normal check during the tenancy.

list.title: Property Condition History
list.subtitle: All inspections of your units, newest first.
list.emptyText: Record a move-in inspection to keep proof of each home's condition.

wizard.chooseUnit: Please choose the unit you are inspecting.
wizard.chooseRoom: Please choose at least one room.
wizard.roomsHelp: Tick the rooms in this unit. You can add other rooms below.
wizard.conditionHelp: For each part, choose the word that best describes it. Describe any problem you see.
wizard.allGood: Mark everything in this room as Good
wizard.notesExample: For example: small crack above the window.
wizard.autosave: Your progress is saved each time you press Next.
wizard.photosHelp: Take photos of each room, especially of any damage.
wizard.photosOptional: Photos are optional but strongly recommended.
wizard.summaryHint: A short overall note, for example “Clean and ready for the tenant.”
wizard.share: Share this record with the tenant
wizard.shareHint: The current tenant can see the conditions and photos (not your private notes).
wizard.lockWarning: When you finish, this inspection is locked as a permanent, dated record. It cannot be changed afterwards.
wizard.completed: The inspection was saved and locked.
wizard.draftSaved: Your inspection was saved. You can continue later.

detail.deleteConfirm: This unfinished inspection and its photos will be removed. This cannot be undone.
detail.lockedText: This inspection is completed and can no longer be changed.
detail.draftText: This inspection is not finished yet. Continue it to finish and lock it.

compare.title: Compare photos
compare.needTwo: At least two photos are needed to compare.
compare.disclaimer: These photos are dated records only. They do not decide who is responsible for any damage — that is for people to agree.
